title: Theseus, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Numismatic recognition for winners and heroes Unique storytelling concept Digital printing of the highest quality Great idea for a gift Theseus volunteered to be one of the fourteen young Athenians sent to Crete as a sacrifice to the Minotaur. With the help of Ariadne he was able to kill the monster inside his Labyrinth. After that, Theseus returned to Athens, where he ruled admirably for many years. This silver coin inspired by his figure will become a pride of your collection.
